```{python}
#| include: false
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

CSV_PATH = Path("leaderboard-summary.csv")
board = pd.read_csv(CSV_PATH)
board = board[board["status"] == "complete"].copy()

OPEN = [
    "leeds-v1", "bristol-v1", "london-v1",
    "paris-v1", "melbourne-v1", "zurich-v1", "toronto-v1",
]
CASES = OPEN + ["leuven-v1"]
CPU_W_PER_THREAD = {
    "AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9975WX 32-Cores": 350.0 / 64.0,
}

go = board[
    (board["split"] == "group_out_pooled")
    & (board["track"] == "uncalibrated")
    & (board["n_sites"] >= 20)
    & board["rho"].notna()
].copy()
go["energy_wh"] = go["cpu_time_s"] * go["cpu_model"].map(CPU_W_PER_THREAD).fillna(6.0) / 3600.0

TOOL_LABELS = {
    "sdna": "sDNA",
    "cityseer_od": "cityseer",
    "aequilibrae": "AequilibraE",
    "una": "UNA",
    "baseline": "Baseline",
}
TIER_SHORT = {
    "T0_network": "T0",
    "T1_open_covariates": "T1",
    "T2_synthetic_od": "T2",
    "T3_observed_od": "T3",
}


def mode_table(mode_id: str) -> str:
    sub = go[go["mode"] == mode_id]
    g = (
        sub.groupby(["tool", "variant", "input_tier"])
        .agg(
            cities=("case_id", "nunique"),
            med_rho=("rho", "median"),
            mean_rho=("rho", "mean"),
            med_r2=("log_r2", "median"),
            med_cov=("coverage", "median"),
            med_wall=("wall_time_s", "median"),
            med_wh=("energy_wh", "median"),
        )
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values(["med_rho", "mean_rho"], ascending=False)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    rows = []
    open_rank = 0
    for _, r in g.iterrows():
        is_bl = r["tool"] == "baseline"
        if is_bl:
            rk = "—"
        else:
            open_rank += 1
            rk = str(open_rank)
        rows.append({
            "Rank": rk,
            "Tool": TOOL_LABELS.get(r["tool"], r["tool"]),
            "Variant": f"`{r['variant']}`",
            "Tier": f"`{TIER_SHORT.get(r['input_tier'], r['input_tier'])}`",
            "Cities": int(r["cities"]),
            "Median ρ": f"{r['med_rho']:.3f}",
            "Mean ρ": f"{r['mean_rho']:.3f}",
            "Median log R²": f"{r['med_r2']:+.3f}",
            "Coverage": f"{r['med_cov']:.2f}",
            "Wall (s)": f"{r['med_wall']:.1f}",
            "Wh/city": f"{r['med_wh']:.2f}" if r["med_wh"] >= 0.01 else "<0.01",
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).to_markdown(index=False, disable_numparse=True)


def city_table(mode_id: str) -> str:
    sub = go[go["mode"] == mode_id]
    rows = []
    for c in CASES:
        cs = sub[sub["case_id"] == c]
        if cs.empty:
            continue
        row = {"City": c.replace("-v1", "") + ("*" if c == "leuven-v1" else "")}
        row["Sites"] = int(cs["n_sites"].iloc[0])
        for tid in ["sdna", "cityseer_od", "aequilibrae", "una", "baseline"]:
            ts = cs[cs["tool"] == tid]
            if ts.empty:
                row[TOOL_LABELS[tid]] = "—"
            else:
                top = ts.loc[ts["rho"].idxmax()]
                row[TOOL_LABELS[tid]] = f"{top['rho']:.3f} (`{top['variant']}`)"
        rows.append(row)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).to_markdown(index=False, disable_numparse=True)
```

All scores below come directly from [`leaderboard-summary.csv`](leaderboard-summary.csv) on the primary **spatial group-out** split (5 folds of 3 km cells, uncalibrated single scale factor $k$, targets with $\ge 20$ sites). See the [paper](paper/index.qmd) for full methodology, leave-one-city-out transfer, and visual comparisons, or the [v0.1.0 release](https://github.com/Robinlovelace/aadtbench/releases/tag/v0.1.0) for case data bundles.

## Compute & energy efficiency

Median per-city resource usage across the seven open cases (16-thread / 3600 s budget; TDP-proportional CPU energy estimated from `cpu_time_s` using 350 W / 64 threads on the host AMD Threadripper PRO 9975WX).

```{python}
res = (
    go[(go["tool"] != "baseline") & go["case_id"].isin(OPEN)]
    .drop_duplicates(["case_id", "tool", "variant", "input_tier"])
    .groupby(["tool", "variant", "input_tier"])[
        ["wall_time_s", "cpu_time_s", "speed_index", "peak_memory_mb", "energy_wh"]
    ]
    .median()
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values("wall_time_s")
)
res["tool"] = res["tool"].map(lambda x: TOOL_LABELS.get(x, x))
res["variant"] = res["variant"].map(lambda x: f"`{x}`")
res["input_tier"] = res["input_tier"].map(lambda x: f"`{TIER_SHORT.get(x, x)}`")
res["wall_time_s"] = res["wall_time_s"].round(1)
res["cpu_time_s"] = res["cpu_time_s"].round(1)
res["speed_index"] = res["speed_index"].round(1)
res["peak_memory_mb"] = res["peak_memory_mb"].round(0).astype(int)
res["energy_wh"] = res["energy_wh"].round(2)
res.columns = ["Tool", "Variant", "Tier", "Wall (s)", "CPU (s)", "Speed idx", "Peak RAM (MB)", "Wh/city"]
Markdown(res.to_markdown(index=False, disable_numparse=True))
```
